answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 24359 Country: TJ Title: Please tell me these all following name is permissible or not and give me its meanings. (1) Cuhrob (2) Rustam (3) Khusrav (4) Jamshed. Its right to keep this names or we have to change the name. Question: Assalamualaikum. Please tell me these all following name is permissible or not and give me its meanings. (1) Cuhrob (2) Rustam (3) Khusrav (4) Jamshed. Its right to keep this names or we have to change the name. Please give the answer at the earliest Answer ID: 24359 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1200/1200/M=1431) Sohrab: It is the name of the son of Rustam wrestler. We could not get its meaning in the dictionary. Rustam: A famous wrestler of Persia whose bravery tales are recorded in Shah Nama. Metaphorically, it means a brave person Khusroo: Beautiful, lovely handsome Jamshed: It was a famous king of Iran. It is said that he got a bowl made in which he used to see the whole world. (Firozul Lughat) You can continue with this name and if you want to change it there is no problem. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
